name: dalimgari
description: Dalimgai - ডালিমগাড়ী shared web application with an Android Capacitor target.

scripts.android:add: npm run build:android && npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-android-deeplink.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android-deeplink.mjs
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && npx cap build android --androidreleasetype APK
